argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $r=[ordered]@{}; $r.time=(Get-Date).ToString('o'); $r.repo=[ordered]@{head=(& git -C E:\pc-github-relay rev-parse HEAD);branch=(& git -C E:\pc-github-relay branch --show-current);status=(@(& git -C E:\pc-github-relay status --short))}; $r.listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalAddress -in @('127.0.0.1','::1','0.0.0.0','::') -and $_.LocalPort -gt 1024 } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess); $r.processes=@(Get-Process chrome,firefox,node,python,pythonw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,MainWindowTitle); $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

note: Read-only diagnostics: verify live relay, browser/Bridge process IDs and listening ports. No credentials, no browser mutations.
